# FinRL: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Library for Automated Stock Trading in Quantitative Finance

arXiv [2011.09607](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.09607) · v1 2020-11-19 · latest 2022-03-02

| **task** | A beginner-friendly deep reinforcement learning library for developing and backtesting automated stock trading strategies (single stock, multiple stock trading, portfolio allocation). | “In this paper, we introduce a DRL library FinRL that facilitates beginners to expose themselves to quantitative finance and to develop their own stock trading strategies.” |
| **architecture** | Three layers: Gym-based market environment (MDP with state, action, reward), DRL agent layer with fine-tuned algorithms, and application layer; lower layers provide APIs to upper layers. | “Three-layer architecture: The three layers of FinRL library are stock market environment, DRL trading agent, and stock trading applications. The agent layer interacts with the environment layer in an exploration-exploitation manner” |
| **data** | Historical data from NASDAQ-100, DJIA, S&P 500, SSE 50, CSI 300, HSI; OHLCV and technical indicators at daily, hourly or minute frequency. Demos use SPY, QQQ, GOOGL, AMZN, AAPL, MSFT and Dow Jones 30 constituents. | “FinRL provides six environments based on representative listings, including NASDAQ-100, DJIA, S&P 500, SSE 50, CSI 300, and HSI, plus one user-defined environment.” |
| **window** | Reported test results cover 2019/01/01-2020/09/23; training/validation split dates not given in text. | “\| 2019/01/01-2020/09/23 \| TD3 \| DDPG \| Min-Var. \| DJIA” |
| **models** | DRL algorithms DQN, DDPG, Multi-Agent DDPG, PPO, SAC, A2C, TD3, based on OpenAI Baselines and Stable Baselines; PPO used for single stock, DDPG and TD3 for multiple stock/portfolio. | “FinRL library includes fine-tuned standard DRL algorithms, namely, DQN [29][34], DDPG [29], Multi-Agent DDPG [30], PPO [40], SAC [18], A2C [33] and TD3 [11].” |
| **baselines** | Buy-and-hold, mean-variance, min-variance, momentum, equal-weighted strategies; in demos, S&P 500 index, DJIA index and min-variance allocation. | “FinRL uses five conventional strategies, namely passive buy-and-hold trading strategy [32], mean-variance strategy [1], and min-variance strategy [1], momentum trading strategy [15], and equal-weighted strategy” |
